tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background: library shelf, panel bodies on iPhone, behind toolbars.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Side panels, popovers, menus, book cards' info area, toasts.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Insets inside raised surfaces: search field, segmented-control track, slider track.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The reader backdrop the PDF pages sit on. Never put text directly on it except the page pill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and around panels. Decorative only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that define a control (search field, segmented track edge, swatch ring). 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in every theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken, canvas and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: authors, page numbers, timestamps, captions, inactive icons. On surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ink blue. Selected and active states, progress fill, links, the current chapter, the primary button fill. Text in accent reads on surface, surface-raised and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills and accent text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button, selected segment, play button). Never hard-code white.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet selected background: current TOC row, active search result, selected chip, pressed toggle.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px gap in the surface colour. 3:1 against every surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (delete book), the recording dot, error toasts' icon. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error toast or a destructive confirm row; danger and ink both read on it.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Sync complete, saved, finished-book badge text. Always with a check icon or a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Background for the finished badge and success toast.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the reader behind an iPhone bottom sheet or a modal.

tokens.name: page-tint
tokens.usage: Multiply overlay on each PDF page: transparent in light, warm paper in sepia, none in dark (dark inverts pages instead).

tokens.name: hl-yellow
tokens.usage: Yellow highlight fill over page text. The default highlight colour.

tokens.name: hl-green
tokens.usage: Green highlight fill over page text.

tokens.name: hl-blue
tokens.usage: Blue highlight fill over page text.

tokens.name: hl-pink
tokens.usage: Pink highlight fill over page text.

tokens.name: swatch-yellow
tokens.usage: Solid chip for the yellow highlight in the highlight menu and annotation lists. Always ringed with line-strong.

tokens.name: swatch-green
tokens.usage: Solid chip for the green highlight.

tokens.name: swatch-blue
tokens.usage: Solid chip for the blue highlight.

tokens.name: swatch-pink
tokens.usage: Solid chip for the pink highlight.

tokens.name: listen-mark
tokens.usage: Tint behind the sentence being read aloud; pair with a 2px accent underline.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Native text selection colour on PDF pages and in panels.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: The one page title per screen: Library. Not inside panels.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Book title on empty states, export header and the iPad library list.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Panel and sheet titles, section headings inside panels.

styles.name: book-title
styles.usage: Book titles on cards and in the reader toolbar. Clamp to two lines on cards, one in the toolbar.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: It is a narrow mind which cannot look at a subject from various points of view.
styles.usage: Highlighted passages quoted in the Notes and Bookmarks panels and share cards.

styles.name: chapter
styles.usage: Table-of-contents entries, chapter name under the toolbar title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Notes stay on this device and sync when you are online.
styles.usage: Running text in panels, note bodies, empty-state text. Also every text input (16px stops iOS zooming in).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, list-row titles.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Authors, page numbers, timestamps, progress text, helper text.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Badges and the page pill. Numbers here use tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; icon-to-label gap in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List-row vertical padding; gap between book cards' cover and text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; the phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Library grid gap and panel section spacing on iPad and Mac.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on iPad and Mac; space above a screen title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding and gaps between major library sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Highlight marks in lists, the progress bar, the cover image corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, search field, segmented options, toast.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, popovers, book-card info block, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Side panel corners on iPad, the listen bar.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: iPhone bottom sheet top corners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, the page pill, swatches, the record button.

tokens.name: shadow-page
tokens.usage: Each PDF page on the canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, the highlight menu, toasts, the floating listen bar.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: iPhone bottom sheets and the iPad side panel edge.

size.note: Fixed dimensions of the reader's chrome.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable, on every device.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Reader toolbar and library header height (plus the safe-area inset on iPhone).

tokens.name: listen-bar-height
tokens.usage: The listen bar docked at the bottom of the reader.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Side panel width on Mac and iPad landscape. Below 720px the panel becomes a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: popover-width
tokens.usage: Reading settings popover and highlight-note editor.

tokens.name: cover-width
tokens.usage: Book cover width in the library grid on iPad and Mac (2:3 aspect). On iPhone covers take a third of the width.

tokens.name: reading-measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for note editors and long text inside panels.

meta.note: Designed from scratch for the phase 14 redesign; not extracted from the existing UI.
